facts.claim: 3857 GOES tiles 256 px: GeoColor max TileMatrix 7 (GoogleMapsCompatible_Level7), Band13 max 6 (Level6); BlueMarble Level8; VIIRS Level9. 4326 GOES tiles 512 px: GeoColor TMS '1km' (TM0-6), Band13 '2km' (TM0-5); TM5 is 40x20 (9 deg per tile).
Tile URL template. Time is YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ (VIIRS YYYY-MM-DD; BlueMarble has no Time). Dimension period PT10M for all GOES layers, P1D for VIIRS.
Earliest listed Time start (3857); each GOES layer lists exactly 100 ranges, so the list looks capped. VIIRS NOAA-20 2018-01-05 to 2026-10-17; SNPP 2015-11-24 to 2026-10-16.

facts.claim: GIBS states GeoColor updates every 10 min with about 40 min latency; probe results (31-41 min) agree.
Capabilities copies are stale and disagree. GeoColor East default: 01:00Z (age 61 s), 01:10Z (4326 copy, age 348 s), 00:30Z (re-fetch, age 1259 s). Use tile probes for 'latest'.

Missing or future times return HTTP 404 (text/html, 196 bytes), including a gap (GOES-West GeoColor 01:00Z). Off-grid times return HTTP 200 with the previous frame's bytes (01:05Z and 01:09Z give 01:00Z).

Montana z5 tiles pass the imagery test (PIL; GOES PNG stored RGBA, JPEG RGB): GeoColor East 4131 distinct RGB, Band13 East 953, GeoColor West 4480, Band13 West 1014; opaque. PNG 48-97 KB per 256 px tile.
VIIRS NOAA-20 default date (2026-10-17, today) is an all-black tile here. 2026-10-16 is valid (11062 colours). The default date is not a valid frame.

CORS: every tile GET sent with an Origin returns Access-Control-Allow-Origin: * (3857 GOES, BlueMarble, VIIRS, 4326, Billings). No-Origin GET, OPTIONS preflight (200) and both capabilities files also return *.
facts.evidence: tile GETs and preflight in urls_checked

facts.claim: GeoColor native resolution: 1 km visible band at the sub-satellite point; full disk every 10 min in Mode 6.
Band 13 native pixel resolution 2 km at sub-satellite point (PDF text layer only; the table does not render). GIBS TMS '2km' agrees.
GIBS latency classes: NRT generated within 3.5 h of observation; STD within 24 h. The GOES layers' class is unverified (catalog gated).

Archive start (tile service, GOES-East Band13): first served date between 2026-07-16 and 07-18 (07-15 12:00Z 404; 07-18 12:00Z 200; noon probes 2025-09-15 to 2026-07-01 all 404). June 2025: Domains lists PT10M segments incl. 2025-06-15, but every tested 2025-06 tile is 404 (zoom 2-5).
facts.value: first served 2026-07-16..18; June 2025 Domains vs tiles inconsistent

facts.claim: Parallax: no GIBS, Earthdata or GeoColor page read mentions parallax or viewing geometry. Parallax correction unverified.
facts.evidence: text search of pages in urls_checked

facts.claim: Satellite identity: NOAA says GOES-18 has been GOES-West since 2023-01-10 and GOES-19 will be declared operational GOES-East (2025-04-04); NOAA guide v1.3 lists GOES-19 as GOES-East. GIBS article names GOES-16/17 (older). GIBS layer-to-satellite mapping unverified.
Derived, not stated by GIBS: 3857 pixel = ScaleDenominator x 0.00028 m. GeoColor Level7 max about 1.22 km; Band13 Level6 max about 2.45 km at the equator.

terms.license: No GIBS-wide licence on the pages read. NASA data freely accessible (CC0 for NASA-led missions unless marked); non-NASA data under the sponsor licence. GOES: NOAA NODD terms (open; attribution requested). VIIRS and BlueMarble sponsor licences unverified.
terms.quote: GIBS: 'We ask that users who make use of GIBS in their clients or when referencing it in written or oral presentations to add the following acknowledgment: We acknowledge the use of imagery provided by services from NASA's Global Imagery Browse Services (GIBS), part of NASA's Earth Science Data and Information System (ESDIS).' NASA: 'NASA data are freely accessible; however, when you publish these data or works based on the data, we request that you cite the datasets within the text of the publication.' NASA: 'Non-NASA data available through the ESDIS project is subject to the license arrangements of the sponsoring organization.' NOAA: 'NOAA data disseminated through NODD are open to the public and can be used as desired.'

limits: Single snapshot, 2026-10-17 UTC: capabilities 01:48Z, tiles 01:50-01:52Z, archive probes 02:01-02:02Z. Re-run before relying on frame numbers. Imagery test is automated (PIL); no tile viewed by eye.
One z5 tile covers only part of Montana; Montana (lon -116.05 to -104.04) needs at least two tiles across.
CORS tested with curl only (Origin http://127.0.0.1:8080). No browser test (rule 8, UI phase).
No general rate limit or quota found. Bulk download is over 1,000,000 tiles per 24 h (contact GIBS 48 h ahead). About 120 requests to gibs.earthdata.nasa.gov in this check.
Quotes are from raw HTML or PDF text (curl, local parse), not model summaries. WebSearch only found URLs.

Earthdata wiki Visualization Product Catalog (https://wiki.earthdata.nasa.gov/x/LgJX) redirects to Earthdata Login. A search snippet claims a GOES-East ABI row at 1 km / 0.5 km sensor / 10 min: unverified.
Docs do not say whether a frame time is scan start, end or processing time (compare NOAA AWS in W2). Off-grid times return the previous frame with HTTP 200: label frames by the bytes returned.
open_questions: Which satellite feeds each GIBS GOES layer now (GOES-19/18 per NOAA; GIBS article says GOES-16/17)? Check NOAA AWS timestamps (W2).
Is GIBS GOES imagery parallax-corrected? No page says. Ask earthdata-support@nasa.gov (address on the bulk-download page).
Why do Domains list June 2025 frames that tiles 404 on? Past-storm replay depth unknown until GIBS answers.
GOES row of the Visualization Product Catalog (resolution, NRT/STD class) needs Earthdata Login.
VIIRS and BlueMarble sponsor licences not checked (NASA CC0 vs non-NASA). Needed before public release.
